label: rem:lepton-discrepancies
title: Electron--muon discrepancies
html: Two structural criteria distinguish lepton generations. These are Reeb-vertical degree of knot localisation (8.10.1), and whether the cyclic symmetry embeds in S_5 (17.2.3). The electron and muon satisfy both. The tau satisfies only the first. Anomalous magnetic-moment tensions and lepton flavour universality violations observed at B-factories may reflect this structural asymmetry rather than new heavy-particle loops. If so, the tension should track the tau channel specifically and not the electron or muon channels, which satisfy both criteria.
